documents.title: Espresso turned suspiciously watery
documents.description: Recent espresso shots were pale and fast while the bean sensor fell below five percent.
documents.resolution: Refilled the bean hopper and ran one calibration espresso.

documents.title: Cappuccino forgot how to foam
documents.description: Cappuccino cycles completed without foam after the milk line disconnected.
documents.root_cause: Milk line disconnected or milk supply empty
documents.resolution: Reconnected and primed the milk line, then tested one cappuccino.

documents.title: Espresso machine running hotter than office gossip
documents.description: Boiler readings exceeded 99 C and several brew cycles aborted for safety.
documents.resolution: Powered down the heater, cleared the vent, and inspected the thermostat.

documents.title: Coffee tastes like a science experiment
documents.description: The machine exceeded its cleaning interval and recent drinks carried bitter warnings.
documents.resolution: Ran the approved cleaning cycle and replaced the brew-group tablet.

documents.title: Reception coffee false alarm
documents.description: Supplies, temperature, pressure, cleaning state, and recent brews were all healthy.
documents.resolution: Confirmed the selected drink recipe and served another test coffee.
